messages:
anya: Posting guidance for Zero-Trust Private deployments and rotation processes. This is a combined doc for customers who need continuous key rotation, immutable configs, and no-downtime operator handoffs. Please review before we publish to the customer portal.

lena: Thanks. Main ask from support: include step-by-step rotation playbooks for KMS keys, container image keys, and audit bundle re-signing.

sneh: Security notes: we recommend rolling rotations with overlap windows and SignedBundle checkpoints. Do not rotate all keys at once.

mika: Adding a short sample workflow for a safe KMS rotation that works with HSM-only setups:

```yaml
rotation_workflow:
  steps:
    - name: provision-new-key
      verify: hsm_attestation
    - name: stage-new-key
      overlap_minutes: 30
    - name: re-encrypt-secrets
      parallel_limit: 10
    - name: swap-active-key
      wait_for_acks: true
    - name: retire-old-key
      retention_days: 7
```

secops: Important: for on-prem customers using SignedBundle enforcement, the bundle SHA must be updated and stored in audit logs before operator role changes. We'll add a sample signed output and where to store it.

anya: Docs-bot, please include a troubleshooting section: common failures include HSM latency, kube-probe timeouts during image pulls, and missing registry creds during retag/push.

docs-bot: Draft published: private/zero-trust-rotation-guide.md (author: anya)

deploy-bot: Deploy started: docs/private/zero-trust-rotation-guide -> staging (build 20260410.3)

lena: Customer comms: we'll call this "Zero-Trust Rotation Playbook" and include an appendix with email templates for notifying auditors. Marco from sales will coordinate timeline.

sneh: Also adding a short script to verify audit log integrity (hash chain) that customers can run locally. Sample POSIX snippet in doc.

anya: Action items: @mika add HSM attestation example, @secops add SignedBundle templates, @lena add auditor email templates, @docs-bot schedule internal review Thurs 11am PT. Goal: publish GA-ready doc by next week. :lock_with_ink_pen:
